hero_banner.description: Hero banner for the shop, minimalist podium with blue and white theme

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure functional components in React (.js files only, not .tsx).
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling according to the guidelines.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or native form elements. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the blue-white theme.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, cart, wishlist, products).
Use lucide-react for standard e-commerce icons (ShoppingCart, Heart, User, Search).

Features required: Product Grid Display, Search Bar, Category Filter Dropdown, Shopping Cart (drawer/modal), Wishlist (toggle), User Authentication (Login/Register dialog/view), Contact Info Section (Footer), Product Detail View (dialog/view), Add to Cart Button, Navigation Header.
Prices must be formatted in VND currency (e.g., 2.490.000 ₫). Provide a utility function for this.
Product cards must have an 'Add to Cart' button and a 'Wishlist' heart icon overlayed on the image or at the bottom corner.
The Hero section should feature the hero_banner image layered with a bold marketing message.
Ensure Header stays sticky and has a glassy blur effect.
Implement states for toggling Wishlist items, Shopping Cart drawer, and Auth. Mock the API interaction.
